title: Identification, phylogenetic analysis and expression profile of an anionic insect defensin gene, with antibacterial activity, from bacterial-challenged cotton leafworm, Spodoptera littoralis.

materials_exhausted.note: Reopened XML, PDF text, OA package images/PDF/NXML, MIQE XLS supplement, locator index, linked APD6 rows, and merged APD6 sequence/activity rows. Remaining gaps are nonblocking scope cautions, not missing local material needed for this paper.

adjudication_summary: Worker-2/4/6 re-review closed rwk-complete-test-0001. Table 3 qualitative antibacterial activity rows are now source-supported, APD6 AP02528 sequence/name/source are source-reviewed with the activity-summary mismatch preserved as source_conflict, and mechanism claims are bounded to structural/phenotypic context rather than direct molecular mechanism.

per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_1_database: Worker-4 reviewed linked APD6 experiment and literature rows plus merged APD6 sequence/activity rows. AP02528 mature sequence/name/source/citation are supported by Figure 3 and article metadata, but APD6 activity text is preserved as source_conflict because it collapses Table 3 qualitative categories and omits Proteus vulgaris.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_2_activity_toxicity: Worker-2 recovered 20 primary-source Table 3 disk-diffusion activity rows with raw qualitative values, units/category legend, targets, sample/timepoint context, assay conditions, replicate note, and locators. No toxicity assay is reported and none was fabricated.
per_layer_decision_rationale.layer_3_mechanism: Worker-6 replaced automated mechanism placeholders with source-reviewed structural defensin context, phenotypic antibacterial activity context, and an explicit mechanism-gap claim. No direct mechanism is asserted.

unrecoverable_material_gaps.why_unrecoverable: The local paper, MIQE supplementary spreadsheet, and linked APD6 rows report antibacterial activity but no hemolysis, cytotoxicity, host-cell toxicity, CC50, HC50, or LD50 assay.
unrecoverable_material_gaps.impact: Toxicity layer remains empty as a source-scope caution; this does not block publication-grade review because the paper is an antibacterial defensin identification/expression study and all reported activity rows are captured.

caution_findings.evidence_context: Table 3 uses (+), +, ++, and +++ symbols relative to the penicillin positive control; it does not give per-target numeric inhibition-zone diameters.
APD6 AP02528 summarizes selected organisms as comparable to penicillin, while Table 3 distinguishes category levels and also includes Proteus vulgaris.
No local XML/PDF/supplement/database material reports hemolysis, cytotoxicity, or host-cell toxicity for SpliDef.
The paper discusses anionic defensin mechanism as poorly known and does not report direct membrane, target-binding, or translation-inhibition assays.
The local XLS supplement parses as a MIQE/qPCR checklist and does not add activity, toxicity, mechanism, or sequence rows beyond the main XML/PDF and figures.
